purpose: Training-label-only geometric plausibility; not a measured explanation of AP
population: Frozen grouped training images, UAV boxes only
anchors: (j+0.5)*stride on640 letterboxed input, strict interior test as in inherited assigner
range: All four target distances must lie strictly inside15*stride, the upper end of16-bin DFL support. This tests representability, not actual assignment.
report: Count targets with zero interior sites, mean interior sites, count with no site also within finest-level DFL range; stratify native area<=16,16-49,>49. Other heads remain available.
limits: Actual TAL assignments also depend on class confidence, overlap and top-k competition. More geometrically eligible sites do not establish better optimization or recovery of lost image information.
